criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1 and 9 pass most of the showstopper test; 4 and 6 solid. 7 reads as a keyboard plate in a void; 3 a straight-on chart, carrier against the dek; 2's board reads as placeholder fill; 5's neck renders as a gap in the outer leaflet; 8's lit floor a broad mid-grey band.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hall, one key, one metal set, one cyan meaning; the tray motif changes state as declared. Reliefs charcoal against navy hall; frame 8's empty background frames contradict frame 9's full dark Frontera towers.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; the speed quoted and never drawn. Looser: frame 4 'four SNAREs' against 'four SNARE protein complexes'; frame 9 headline 'The work moved.' unscoped; '860 compute nodes' present tense from a production-era release; frame 8 draws Horizon in Frontera's hall while the record's no. 17 entry places Horizon in a new Round Rock data center; frame 5's headline states the model as fact. No hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and roughly where; stake general and a question; no deadline, route or place for Horizon.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 9 closes the loop; 3 and 9 repeat the comparison; 4 and 5 a detour.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean with no house rule breaks; hedges repeat into compliance language; Texas specificity stops at Austin; the closing question generic.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: First TACC deck since no. 17; server towers despite the storyboard's own note; cold flood night interior repeats no. 70; black plate count reliefs echo no. 72.

one_sentence_fix: Cut frame 3 and spend the slot on Horizon's own fetched place and status rather than drawing it into Frontera's hall.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat framed rectangle in a void; the eight a thin strip; dead lower quarter.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bleed the field off three edges; lower the rake so only the eight cast long.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Straight-on plan, carrier tight under the dek.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the carrier 120 px, bleed it off the bottom, rake lower.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Board a mid-grey field of white rectangles reads as placeholder.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Near-black graphite with fine copper traces, populated DIMM slots.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Neck renders as a dark gap breaking the outer leaflet.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Continuous hourglass head rows, no carrier showing between them.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Broad mid-grey pool; empty background frames contradict frame 9.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tighten the flood; remove or darken the background frames.
